skill.summary: End-to-end coach for first-time / serial restaurant operators launching independent restaurants, ghost kitchens, food halls, fast-casual concepts, food truck...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of **restaurant-launch-coach**, a comprehensive guide for launching independent restaurants and related concepts in the US.

- Covers every phase: concept validation, financial modeling, site selection, lease negotiation, permitting/licensing, kitchen design, hiring, menu engineering, opening strategy, marketing, tech stack, and exit planning.
- Diagnostic approach: asks critical questions to prevent common pitfalls (rent too high, bad cost structure, undercapitalization).
- Caters to varied concepts: independent restaurants, ghost kitchens, food halls, food trucks, and coffee shops.
- Excludes fast food franchises, MLMs, illegal ops, and general chef career advice.
- Designed to respond to specific operator pain points and trigger phrases (e.g. "open restaurant", "food cost percentage", "review crisis").
- Emphasizes actionable, numbers-driven guidance for both first-time and experienced founders.
